publisher: Historic England via GOV.UK / National Data Library
evidence_slice: GOV.UK/National Data Library catalogue record 'Listed Buildings Polygon GIS data', published by Historic England, states that GIS spatial data for Listed Buildings is available, that polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011, and that the dataset is licensed under the Open Government Licence. The catalogue page provides a data-download/WMS link but does not expose a Rougemont Castle record or record-level polygon coordinates in this source window.

field_evidence.footprint: Catalogue metadata confirms a polygon GIS dataset but exposes no Rougemont Castle record-level polygon coordinates in this source window.
field_evidence.type_use: This catalogue window is dataset-level metadata and contains no record-bound Rougemont Castle type/use payload.
field_evidence.coverage: Catalogue summary states polygons are available for listed buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011.
